About the Ride Pleasant Streets group ride

Ride Pleasant Streets is a social group ride in Cincinnati, OH. It rolls every other Saturday at 2:05 pm from Community Happens Here.

Neighborhood rides out of Pleasant Ridge with a safety talk first. First Saturdays are short, third Saturdays longer. Routes favor low-stress streets and paths and are shared a few days ahead.
